statement.text:
Suppose that G is a solvable finite group and A is a group of automorphisms
of G of relatively prime order. Is there a bound for the Fitting height h(G) of G in
terms of A and h(CG (A)), or even in terms of the length l(A) of the longest chain of
nested subgroups of A and h(CG (A))?
   When A is solvable, it is proved in (A. Turull, J. Algebra, 86 (1984), 555–566)
that h(G) ⩽ h(CG (A)) + 2l(A) and this bound is best possible for h(CG (A)) > 0.
For A non-solvable some results are in (H. Kurzweil, Manuscripta Math., 41 (1983),
233–305).                                                                   A. Turull
